notes.title: v2.6
notes.content:
1. Slightly increase the requirement for item production power, so that players need more resources and skills when making items

2. Slightly reduce the realm bonus of alchemists, alchemists, and cultivators to prevent some players from using these skills to gain too much advantage.

3. Modify the display name of the item level

4. Add the option to assign mining and tree cutting tasks with one click, allowing players to quickly complete these tasks and improve game efficiency

5. Add the option of one click full recruitment, allowing players to quickly recruit their own teams and improve the convenience of the game.

6. rarity+1 and number of entries+1. If duplicate entries are merged, they may appear less, but the amount is larger

7. Battle add hidden result display button

8. The backpack should have display words for entries, which can increase the readability and usability of the game.

9. Slightly increase the requirement for the highest quality of clothing synthesis by 3=5. This suggestion can increase the difficulty and challenge of the game, making players need more effort and skills to obtain high-quality equipment.
